crossRefs.note: Of the tribe of the children of Dan a prince, Bukki the son of Jogli.
Jacob traveled to Succoth, built himself a house, and made shelters for his livestock. Therefore the name of the place…

translations.web: They came near to him, and said, “We will build sheepfolds here for our livestock, and cities for our little ones;
translations.bsb: Then the Gadites and Reubenites approached Moses and said, “We want to build sheepfolds here for our livestock and cities for our little ones.
translations.kjv: And they came near unto him, and said, We will build sheepfolds here for our cattle, and cities for our little ones:
translations.asv: And they came near unto him, and said, We will build sheepfolds here for our cattle, and cities for our little ones:
